plan.sampling_rule: One fixed seeded rollout per task; all outcomes included, no success filtering.

training_grid.ordering: Configuration order; benchmark scene/object identities recorded in sidecars.

evaluation_grid.ordering: Eight unseen-scene tasks, then eight unseen-object tasks.

selection.selection_rule: For each original held-out task, select the earliest successful episode from the fixed samples. For reviewed tasks 73, 357, select the shortest successful rollout (then earliest episode). All outcomes retained; qualitative success montage, not an aggregate success-rate estimate.
